# Dataset v4

In-place buildings-only labels (`own_range_grid`), AHN4 DTM as the ground, and mask value 255 where the label is not claimed. v2 was not modified. The v2 image and incidence are copied. `label_version` is `v4-inplace-dtm-ign`.

Ignore = (a) the projection said unknown, or (b) nDSM > 3 m outside footprints dilated 1 m and then dilated another 2 m, or (c) the full-DSM label disagrees with the buildings-only label. Water is not in (b) or (c).

A strip is in the set when, on its v2 tiles, layover − nominal is at least +1.0 dB in both the near and the middle third. Water and ignored pixels are out of that contrast. Below +1.5 dB is flagged, not dropped. A tile is dropped only when more than 60% of it is ignored.
